description: A Python export is hexa_public when the run of # comment lines directly above it, or above its first decorator, or above the module's __all__ assignment, carries @hexa:public; nothing else changes.

specs.description: A tagged top-level def is public
specs.given:
A Python file `lib.py` whose source is `# @hexa:public
def connect():
    pass
` and has no `__all__`

specs.description: The tag may be on any line of a multi-line comment run
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `# Opens a session.
# @hexa:public
# Thread-safe.
class Client:
    pass
`

specs.description: A tagged top-level assignment is public
specs.given: A Python file whose source is `# @hexa:public\nDEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30\n`

specs.description: For a decorated def, the comment run above the first decorator counts
For a decorated class, the comment run above the first decorator counts
A blank line ends the comment run
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `# @hexa:public

def connect():
    pass
`

specs.description: A blank line inside the run cuts off the tag above it
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `# @hexa:public

# Opens a connection.
def connect():
    pass
`

specs.description: A trailing comment belongs to the code line it ends, not to the next definition
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `VERSION = "1.0"  # @hexa:public
def connect():
    pass
`
specs.then: The export named `VERSION` has `hexa_public: true`, because its own line carries the tag. The export named `connect` has `hexa_public: false`

specs.description: A tag in a docstring is not a # comment
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `def connect():
    """@hexa:public"""
    pass
`

specs.description: A tag above one definition does not carry over to the next one
A tagged private name does not become an export
specs.given:
A Python file with no `__all__`, whose source is `# @hexa:public
def _helper():
    pass
`

specs.description: The tag must be on a comment line of the run, not on a line further up
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `# @hexa:public
x = 1
# helper
def connect():
    pass
`

specs.description: An export is public exactly when its directly-above comment run carries the tag
specs.given: Any Python source made of top-level defs, classes and assignments, each optionally decorated, with any arrangement of `#` comment lines, trailing comments and blank lines above each, and no tag above `__all__`
specs.then: For every returned export, `hexa_public` is true if and only if some line of the unbroken run of whole-line `#` comments directly above the definition (or above its first decorator) contains `@hexa:public`. A blank line ends the run, and a comment that trails code does not count for the next definition

specs.description: A tag above __all__ marks every listed name
specs.then: The exports are exactly `connect` and `Client`, and both have `hexa_public: true`

specs.description: Tagged __all__ names are never reported as dead exports
specs.given: A project with one Python module whose tagged `__all__` lists `connect`, and no file in the project names `connect`

specs.description: An untagged __all__ marks nothing
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `__all__ = ["connect"]

def connect():
    pass
`

specs.description: A blank line between the tag and __all__ cuts it off
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `# @hexa:public

__all__ = ["connect"]

def connect():
    pass
`

specs.description: A tag on one listed definition does not mark the other listed names
specs.given:
A Python file whose source is `__all__ = ["a", "b"]

# @hexa:public
def a():
    pass

def b():
    pass
`

specs.description: With a tagged __all__, every export is public
specs.given: Any Python source that assigns `__all__` with a list of names, with a `#` run directly above the assignment that contains `@hexa:public`
specs.then: Every returned export is a name `__all__` lists, and every returned export has `hexa_public: true`

specs.description: An untagged Python export is graded as before
specs.given: A project with one Python module whose `__all__` is untagged and lists `helper`, and no file in the project names `helper`
specs.then: `dead_exports` holds an entry for `helper` in that module

specs.description: Other languages still read the tag
specs.given: A TypeScript file, a Rust file and a Go file, each declaring one exported item preceded by its language's `@hexa:public` comment and one exported item without it
specs.when: `extract_exports` is called on each with its own language
specs.then: In each file the tagged item has `hexa_public: true` and the untagged item has `hexa_public: false`, as before this ADR

specs.description: The tag does not change which names are Python exports
specs.given: A Python file with a tagged `__all__ = ["a"]` that also defines `a`, `b` and `_c`
specs.then: Only `a` is returned. Neither `b` nor `_c` is added by the tag

specs.description: An internal module's __all__ is not treated as public
specs.given: A project with an internal Python module whose `__all__` lists `x` and `y`, carries no tag, and only `x` is named by another file

specs.description: Without the tag, Python extraction is unchanged
specs.given: Any Python source in which the text `@hexa:public` does not appear
specs.then: Every returned export has `hexa_public: false`. The returned names, lines and kinds are the same as before this ADR

specs.description: Non-Python extraction is unchanged
specs.given: Any TypeScript, Rust or Go source
specs.then: The result, including every `hexa_public` value, is identical to what it was before this ADR
